rule: Check the operator's own draft before any post. The checker will accept anyone's text, but do not go collect other accounts. Do not ask the user to read this repo.

playbooks.when: First action in this checkout, before any check.
Read once at boot, before checking any text that might not be the operator's.
Before sending, scheduling, or handing back a post draft. This is the account checking its own links first.
When the bot has an X MCP server named x. Plan calls, run them, save raw JSON, ingest.
When reviewing links this account has already posted and X MCP is unavailable. Requires a bearer token.
